title: Determinant algorithm on encoded matrices
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and let $R$ be a finite list of natural-number rows, each of length equal to the number of rows in $R$. Applying the determinant-modulo algorithm to the pair encoding of the binary expansion of $p$ and the encoding of $R$ returns the binary expansion of the determinant of the square matrix over $ br/p br$ whose $(i,j)$ entry is the $j$th entry of row $i$, interpreted modulo $p$, with missing entries taken to be zero.
hypotheses_covered: Every row in $R$ has length equal to the number of rows in $R$.
